retain hits not on an --exclude path —
the caller's subtraction, never the verdict's:
the signals below still read the whole vault

span.p:
search::lexical_evidence:
query_terms → fts_tokens (a temp FTS5 table
built with the index's own tokenizer) folds
spellings the index treats as one token;
then one df count per distinct term

span.p:
EvidenceBar::for_model —
device suffix stripped (…@metal);
a calibrated bar, or None
(fake or unmeasured model)

span.p:
vouched = IDF-weighted term coverage
clears min_term_coverage,
OR best_cos clears min_cos
(bar values live in BGE_BASE_EVIDENCE_BAR)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
resolve_note_hits: chunks sharing a note
collapse onto its best-scoring chunk;
note_exists guard; title + query-windowed
snippet (query_snippet); stop at limit

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SearchEvidenceView: rows (score, snippet,
per-hit bm25_rank / vector_rank / cos)
+ vouched + per-term df/idf + best_cos

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CLI human mode — search_report:
vouched = false → “No matches.” and none of
the rows (strict: no reveal, no --all);
true or None → the rows

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CLI --json: the whole view as an object —
rows served even at vouched: false,
beside the explicit verdict

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Desktop: host returns the view whole (E3);
the frontend applies the rule at one boundary
(doSearch — ui/src/main.ts):
vouched === false → no rows kept
